by: the Phase 5 agent (as written, no person)
decided: Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed; whitespace anywhere else is invalid.
Units are lowercase only: `3S`, `3MS` and `3Ms` are invalid.
Leading zeros are invalid, except the single digit `0`.
A count may exceed the next unit's size (`90m` is valid); units must still appear in descending order, each at most once.
The empty string and a bare number without a unit are invalid.
No weeks, years or fractional components.
A total above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER is rejected at parse time, never clamped.
Parse errors carry "duration" in their message; format errors carry "milliseconds".
`formatDuration(0)` is `"0ms"`; every other result omits zero components.
